summary: Celularity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 23, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for up to $25.0 million of senior secured convertible notes plus warrants in two tranches. The initial September 24 closing issued roughly $11.01 million principal notes at a $1.50 conversion price and warrants for about 4,037,000 shares at $1.50, representing eleven warrant shares per twenty conversion shares. Tranche 1 totals $15.0 million; Tranche 2 adds $10.0 million. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution, security terms and subsequent closings.
